reviews.title: Haven't gone wrong with Thermaltake yet!
reviews.comment: Highly recommend going with this brand for a psu. They're very stable, and I've gone through several builds and rebuilds using the same power supply. The fact that now you have the smart zero fan tech to reduce noise further, just makes it that much more appealing. Yes, it's got RGB, but there's a button on the back of it by the plug that you can just turn it off if you don't want that. Saves on power anyhow, right? Fully modular, this guy will keep you going for quite some time. Just don't go overboard on power demands. It's not a nuclear reactor after all. Buy with confidence!
